verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that LocalAI ships a built-in web interface for chatting with models with no extra tools needed (localai-docs-20). They also describe chat UI interactions such as hovering over a saved message to Edit it (localai-docs-14/28) and a built-in Discover page for installing models (localai-docs-6). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the web chat UI, and deeper documentation of chat UI features (conversation history management, parameter controls, screenshots).
